Schnittstelle Eq<SELF extends Eq<?>>

Typparameter:
SELF - The type implementing this interface.
Funktionsschnittstelle:
Dies ist eine funktionale Schnittstelle, die somit als Zuweisungsziel für einen Lambdaausdruck oder eine Methodenreferenz verwendet werden kann.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Eq<SELF extends Eq<?>>

A functional interface for defining equality operations. Inspired by Haskell's Eq typeclass, this interface allows for flexible implementation of equality criteria.

This interface supports:

  • Type-safe equality, defined by the method eq(Eq).
  • Custom equality using BiPredicate, defined by the method eq(BiPredicate, Eq).
  • Standard hash value calculation, provided by the method hash().
  • Custom hash value calculation, defined by the method hash(Function).

Seit:
1.0.0

    • eq

      boolean eq(@NonNull SELF other)

      Checks if the current object equals the given object.

      Parameter:
      other - The object to check equality with.
      Gibt zurück:
      true if both objects are equal, false otherwise.
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - If other is null.
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • eq

      default boolean eq(@NonNull BiPredicate<SELF,SELF> equals, @NonNull Eq<SELF> other)

      Performs an equality check using custom comparison logic.

      Parameter:
      equals - A custom comparison logic represented by a BiPredicate.
      other - The object to check equality with. Must not be null.
      Gibt zurück:
      true if both objects are considered equal according to the provided comparison logic; false otherwise.
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - If either equals or other is null.
      Seit:
      1.0.0
